product_overview: SizeToolsHub is a multi-category, multi-language static site built with Astro that provides size and unit conversion tools across several everyday domains. It also exposes lightweight backend APIs for health monitoring and listing available converters and metadata.
core_goals: Provide reliable conversion tooling across supported size and unit categories
Expose a public health check endpoint for operational monitoring
Expose a public converters metadata endpoint for listing categories and default units
Support a static, performant, and easily testable backend surface for the site

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: A public endpoint for checking whether the service is operational and reporting basic runtime details such as app name and version.
user_flows: GET /api/health.json with no authentication -> Receive 200 with HealthStatus payload including operational status, app name, and version
GET /api/health.json when the service is unavailable or misconfigured -> Receive a non-200 error response or degraded status information indicating the system is not healthy

features.name: Categories & Converters Metadata API
features.description: A public endpoint that returns the available conversion tools, their categories, and default unit metadata for discovery and UI population.
user_flows: GET /api/converters.json with no authentication -> Receive 200 with ConverterList payload containing all available converters, categories, and default units
GET /api/converters.json when the endpoint cannot produce metadata -> Receive an error response indicating metadata is unavailable or the request failed
